requests.reply: {"translations": ["Seoyun, are you still at the company?", "Yeah ㅠㅠ The meeting isn't over. Jiwoo, did you leave work?", "I just left. But did the contract finish well?"]}
{"translations": ["Yeah, I stamped it yesterday. It's finally over now.", "Wow, only three days left.", "I know ㅠㅠ There's so much to do."]}
{"translations": ["Did you call a moving company?", "No haha, partial move. I'm moving on Saturday, but I have to pack the stuff myself.", "What about the cat? It's going to be chaos on moving day"]}

{"translations": ["On Saturdays, I leave Bori at the pet hotel. They asked for an English name on the reservation form, so I wrote Barley haha", "ㅋㅋㅋㅋ I always get confused whether Bori was male or female", "She's female. She's three years old but is still shy"]}

{"translations": ["After moving, let's rest on Sunday. I miss Bori too haha. Want to grab brunch?", "Okay! Hyejin unnie is coming to help with the cleanup on Sunday.", "Oh, that's good. Then Bori will be home that day too?"]}

{"translations": ["Yeah, oppa said he'll take me on Sunday morning.", "That's a relief. Should I call Subin too? ◆", "I asked, but Subin said she can't come on Sunday. She said she has a prior engagement."]}

{"translations": ["Too bad. Ah, what is Chaeyul's English name? I need to send a calendar invite.", "They said to use Chaeyul. Not 'Chaeyool' haha.", "Okay. What about the sofa? Bori always slept there."]}

{"translations": ["I posted it on Carrot and got contacted right away. We decided to meet in person tomorrow evening.", "Wow, that's fast. Seoyun, you really cherished that sofa.", "Right ㅠㅠ But my new house is small, so it can't be helped."]}

{"translations": ["Did you get the deposit for the old house? The landlady was quite strict.", "Not yet ㅠㅠ She told me to clean properly, so I have to wipe everything before Sunday.", "Wow, Sunday is a day off. Let's ask Chaeyul to do it haha"]}

{"translations": ["No, I quit last year and now I run a cafe. But I'll tell you the tips.", "Thanks haha, Jiwoo, did you send the Monday meeting invitation to Chaeyul too?", "Yes, I just sent it. By the way, is it okay for Bori to take a car?"]}
{"translations": ["He runs away as soon as he sees the carrier haha. I'll lure him with snacks."]}
